title: GovEagle adds video and audio search to the Content Library
summary: GovEagle now searches video and audio recordings. Ask about orals rehearsals or customer calls and jump to the cited moment.
body_markdown:
You can now upload video and audio recordings to GovEagle and ask about them the same way you ask about a document.


## What changed


- **Citations with timestamps.** Every answer cites a time range. Click it and the recording plays from the start of that range.
- **Transcript and moments.** Each recording gets a timestamped transcript and is split into moments, each with a title, a short summary and start and end times.
- **It reads the screen, too.** For video, GovEagle reads what's shown as well as what's said, so silent screen recordings work as well.


## Who it helps


Teams with knowledge locked in recordings: orals rehearsals, customer calls and screen-recorded walkthroughs. After a dry run, an orals coach can ask *"Summarize the rehearsal and list each topic with its time range"* and jump straight to the section that needs another pass, instead of scrubbing through an hour of footage.


## How GovEagle video and audio search works


1. In **Content Library** , open a folder and choose **Upload** → **Upload new content** . You can also attach a recording in chat, to opportunity assets, to tasks, or from the Word add-in.
2. Upload MP4 video or M4A, MP3 or WAV audio, up to 1 GB and 60 minutes per file.
3. Ask a question in chat.
4. Click any citation to jump to that moment, or browse the **Moments** and **Transcript** views.


Uploading to the content library needs the **Edit Content Library** permission, which Admins and Content Managers have by default. Members can still attach recordings in chat.


Get GovCon capture and proposal insights in your inbox.


## Where it fits


Recordings sit alongside your past proposals and reference documents in[GovEagle's knowledge management](https://www.goveagle.com/solutions/knowledge-management) . For more on running orals, read[how to prepare slide decks and oral presentations](https://www.goveagle.com/blog/slide-decks-oral-presentations-govcon-strategies) .


## What it doesn't do


- **No speaker labels.** The transcript is timestamped but doesn't say who is talking.
- **Not every format.** MOV, WEBM, AVI, MKV, OGG, AAC and FLAC aren't supported.
- **Synced SharePoint folders aren't processed yet.** Upload those recordings directly.
- **It isn't on by default.** Video and audio uploads are turned on per organization.
